title: Martha is not wrong….but
theme: Martha and Mary; busyness and faith; anxiety; serving God; spending time with God; spiritual priorities; being present with Jesus.
opening: I think the opening should be just one question:  Opening  Can we become so busy doing things for God that we forget to simply be with Him?
prayer: Lord, when I become anxious with all I think I need to do, draw me back to You. Teach me to sit at Your feet, listen, and remember what matters most. Amen.
body:
Martha is serving Jesus. Mary is sitting at His feet listening.

Jesus never tells Martha that serving is wrong. He tells her she is “anxious and worried about many things.” And of Mary, He says she has chosen the better part.

That makes me wonder how often we confuse doing for God with being close to God.

We serve. We give. We volunteer. We pray. We try to do what is right. And somewhere along the way, we can begin to believe that the more we do, the closer we must be getting to heaven.

But Mary isn’t doing anything for Jesus.

She is with Him.

Maybe that is what makes this Gospel a little uncomfortable.

We can become so busy doing things for God that we forget to simply be with Him.

And maybe the question worth sitting with today is this:

Does God primarily want what I can do for Him—or does He want me?
